data.name: about_title1
data.value: ICAN is a Thai IT Solution provider company based in Bangkok, Thailand established in 1999. The main business of ICAN is to provide customer services on customization and development of both hardware installations (e.g. Servers, PC, Network and Equipments, Site Preparation) and software implementations (e.g. SAP, E-Commerce, Customizing customer specified Software)

data.name: about_title2
data.value: ICAN has its own methodology in implementing a project to the clientele - provides all kinds of solutions from the beginning of the project until the end. ICAN even extends further support services after the project has been launched.

data.name: about_title3
data.value: A principle of ICAN is to bring to the investors their returns and meet their requirements satisfactorily. Thus, ICAN brings technology closer to the clients. Likewise, ICAN helps companies build, integrate and operate information systems to enhance financial condition in today’s globally competitive driven market.

data.name: about_title4
data.value: All these feats of ICAN are accomplished because of the pool of experts that have already established a tremendously excellent reputation in the computer world.
